sampling_model.design: For each \(n\), observe an independent sample \(O_{n1},\ldots,O_{nn}\) from the row law \(P_n\in\mathcal M\); rows may vary arbitrarily with \(n\).
sampling_model.units: The number of multinomial atoms \(|\mathcal J|\) is fixed, while their probabilities may vanish with \(n\).
sampling_model.treatment: The instrument and treatment are binary; the outcome has the fixed ordered support \(\mathcal Y\), and selection is observed.
sampling_model.overlap: The inferential class strengthens the inherited pointwise model only by fixed uniform bounds \(\epsilon\le P_n(Z=1\mid X=x)\le1-\epsilon\) and \(M(p_n)\ge m_*\); individual cells and cut gaps may vanish.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The empirical atom vector \(\widehat p_n\) is the sole first-stage estimator. Algebraic division is totalized by \(u\oslash0=0\), the endpoint center uses \(\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(\widehat p_n)=(0,1)\) at zero aggregate empirical mass, and \(C_n=\mathbb R^2\) when that fallback is invoked or the legal base set is empty. The common Gaussian draw is realized through the principal covariance square root, and its measurable critical value uses the lower-quantile convention. No support screening, variance floor, or deterministic calibration guard is used.

Several high-level partial-identification assumptions are constraint qualifications with stringent geometry.

body.tldr: The accepted parent continues to identify the causal set sharply as \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\), and the proposed common-Gaussian rectangle is a well-defined measurable statistic.  This note does not establish its uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays.  What is proved is exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) calibration at every fixed separated regular face, uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, an explicit \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic with exact limiting coverage, a \(K=4\) counterexample to every even symmetric-probe reduction, and an oriented repair on that single counterexample face.  The all-array claim is retained only as the open legal-relative-comparison question because the global simultaneous-face oriented comparison and its scale-relative critical-value transfer remain unresolved.

project_justification.gap: The accepted parent settles sharp identification for the finite ordered survivor-complier benefit interval.  Existing inference results do not supply the legal observed-law inner-neighborhood comparison and relative critical-value transfer needed here when support, active-cut gaps, and both endpoint scales may collapse.  The explicit singleton-cell construction additionally proves that an even symmetric maximum of linear probes cannot provide that comparison.
project_justification.niche: The fixed finite multinomial model permits a total semialgebraic endpoint extension, a measurable nearby-legal-base directional envelope, and common-Gaussian calibration.  These ingredients give exact oracle behavior on separated faces and root-\(n\) width control without individual cell or variance floors.  Legality is nevertheless intrinsically oriented at binding selection-total faces, and simultaneous capacity and cut faces remain the unresolved geometry.
project_justification.fill: The proved contribution is diagnostic rather than a general honesty theorem: it combines the imported sharp endpoint map with a measurable total procedure, exact separated-face oracle calibration, uniform width and fallback control, an explicit \(K=4\) stress-test array, a counterexample ruling out every even symmetric-probe reduction, and an exact oriented repair on the counterexample face.  The former all-array theorem is retracted and merged into an explicit open question.  No support, cut-gap, cell-mass, or variance floor, screening rule, or deterministic guard is introduced.

body.related_work: The accepted CausalSmith survivor-complier benefit result supplies the exact sharp endpoint formula and full-law sharpness; identification is imported rather than reproved.  Angrist, Imbens, and Rubin (1996) support conditional instrument randomization, treatment consistency, and no defiers, while Dong and Heiler (2026) support treatment-mediated selection and outcome consistency together with covariate-specific weak selection monotonicity.  The fixed \(\epsilon\) overlap bound and fixed \(m_*\) aggregate denominator floor are uniform-class strengthenings here.  Fang and Santos (2019) and Hong and Li (2018) motivate derivative-aware resampling, but their generic results do not construct the required nearby legal observed laws.  Frandsen and Pond (2025), Imai and Okamoto (2026), and Andrews and Guggenberger (2009) begin from regular, asymptotically linear, or standardized representations that do not resolve the present one-sided legal-face problem at vanishing scale.  The available scale-free unsigned-Gaussian result cannot justify the needed non-even maximum.  Accordingly, the proved separated-face and diagnostic results are presented separately from the unresolved all-array question.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The strongest failed route is now sharply delimited.  The \(K=4\) singleton-cell witness proves that no even functional \(\max_\nu|a_\nu^{\mathsf T}z|\) lying below the legal envelope can dominate all nearby endpoint increments.  A one-sided ray and an explicit survivor-to-never-selected transfer repair parity and finite curvature on that face.  Globally, however, intersections of raw-capacity zeros, selection-total ties, and tied lower or upper cuts permit cancellations among numerator, denominator, and cut derivatives; a face row's positive part is therefore not known to be pointwise bounded by the full directional envelope.  Because the legal donor transfer changes both outcome margins, a complete row-by-row covariance-traction certificate is also absent.  Without those deterministic results, no scale-relative lower-quantile transfer or exact-zero-scale argument is available, so all-array uniform joint coverage remains open.
body.honest_scope: Sharp identification is imported from the accepted parent.  This note proves that the total procedure is measurable, proves exact oracle \(1-\alpha\) coverage only at fixed separated regular faces, proves uniformly negligible fallback probability and \(O_{P_n}(n^{-1/2})\) finite-coordinate width, proves the stated \(K=4\) changing-support diagnostic, refutes all even symmetric-probe reductions on an explicit legal \(K=4\) face, and proves an oriented repair only on that face.  It does not prove global oriented comparison, scale-relative critical-value validity, or uniform joint coverage over arbitrary triangular arrays.  No individual support, survivor-cell, cut-gap, or variance floor and no screening or deterministic guard is imposed.
body.interpretation: The causal target remains the same-unit benefit probability \(\theta_B\), and the imported identification theorem gives its sharp identified set \(\Theta_I(p)=[L(p),U(p)]\).  The empirical center, directional envelope, Gaussian critical value, and rectangle are observed-law procedures; they do not define the causal target.  At separated regular faces the rectangle has exact oracle Gaussian calibration.  Uniformly over the maintained class, its fallback event is negligible and its finite coordinate widths are root-\(n\) on the complementary event.  These properties, and exact calibration on the explicit \(K=4\) diagnostic array, do not imply uniform coverage over all changing-support and tied-face arrays.
